purpose: Make the frozen Legacy seven-phase invocation order executable while keeping priority, registration and callback implementation details outside the preserved fact.

provenance.notes: An external C++17 harness was compiled against a clean extraction of the frozen archive with w64devkit GCC 16.2.0 and run twice. The main build only consumes the pinned traces and an independent probe; it has no Legacy include or link dependency.

expected_facts.claim: A due probe in each phase runs once at t0 in environment, perturbation, input, process, output, interaction and evaluation order.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Phase, event, sequence, probe, step, time and multiplicity fields are exact.

expected_facts.claim: Scrambled registration and cross-phase priority order both differ from the observed macro phase order.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Registration, priority and observed phase sequences are compared exactly.

expected_facts.claim: The trace is tied to the frozen Legacy archive, phase metadata, simulator implementation, passing runtime test, capture harness and canonical environment evidence.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Paths, byte counts and SHA-256 values are exact.

acceptance: Verifies frozen source, environment, harness and runtime-test identities before comparing behavior
Two raw Legacy captures normalize to one byte-independent semantic trace after excluding only rerun_index
Independent C++17 scheduling and Python trace validation agree with all seven Legacy events
Rejects a process/output swap and a duplicate input phase
Preserve and Retire recommendations remain visibly pending until the repository owner accepts the disposition choice
